headline: RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026
title: RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026: 590 Posts, Last Date 14 October
description: RRB Paramedical 2026 (CEN 05/2026) is open for 590 posts across 9 categories, with starting basic pay from ₹21,700 to ₹44,900. Apply on rrbapply.gov.in by 14 October 2026, 11:59 pm. Fee ₹500, or ₹250 for SC, ST, women and other listed groups. Eligibility, age and RRB-wise vacancies on Dishalu.
alt: Red information card. Text: RRB Paramedical Recruitment 2026. Total posts 590. Starting basic pay ₹21,700 to ₹44,900. Application fee ₹500 / ₹250. Last date 14 October 2026.

title: CDAC Recruitment 2026: 858 Posts, No Fee, Apply by 26 October
description: C-DAC recruitment 2026 (CORP/JIT/03/2026) is open for 858 contract posts across 12 centres, including Project Engineer and Project Associate. There is no application fee. Apply on careers.cdac.in by 26 October 2026. Centre-wise vacancies, pay, age limit and eligibility on Dishalu.
alt: The white C-DAC office building in Kolkata with palm trees in front. Text: CDAC Recruitment 2026. Vacancies 858 posts. Application fee nil. Job type contract. Last date 26 Oct 2026.

headline: RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026
title: RRB NTPC Graduate Recruitment 2026: 3,548 Posts, Apply by 6 November
description: RRB NTPC Graduate 2026 (CEN 06/2026) is open for 3,548 posts, including 2,750 Goods Train Manager posts. Any graduate aged 18 to 33 can apply by 6 November 2026, 11:59 PM. Fee ₹500, or ₹250 for SC, ST, women and other listed categories. Eligibility, vacancies and exam pattern on Dishalu.

label: LAW ENTRANCE
headline: CLAT 2027 Registration
title: CLAT 2027 Registration: Last Date 31 October, Exam on 6 December
description: CLAT 2027 registration closes on 31 October 2026 at 11:59 PM. The exam is on Sunday, 6 December 2026, 2 to 4 PM, offline. Fee ₹4,000 for General and OBC, ₹3,500 for SC, ST, BPL and PwD. 120 MCQs in 2 hours with 0.25 negative marking. Eligibility, pattern and the 26 NLUs on Dishalu.
alt: Green information card. Text: CLAT 2027 Registration. Last date to apply 31 October 2026. Exam date 6 December 2026. Fee ₹4,000 / ₹3,500. Paper 120 MCQs in 2 hours.

label: AP GOVT SCHEME
headline: Deepam 2: Your 2nd Free Gas Cylinder
title: Deepam 2: Claim Your 2nd Free Gas Cylinder Before 30 November 2026
description: Under Deepam 2, Andhra Pradesh families with a rice card and an LPG connection get 3 free cylinders a year. The 2nd cylinder of 2026-27 can be booked till 30 November 2026. You pay at delivery and the subsidy is credited to your bank account. Eligibility, booking steps and what to do if the money does not come, on Dishalu. Photo: தகவலுழவன் / Wikimedia, CC BY-SA 3.0.
alt: A red LPG gas cylinder against a blue wall. Text: Deepam 2: Your 2nd Free Gas Cylinder. Free cylinders 3 a year. Claim 2nd by 30 Nov 2026. State Andhra Pradesh. Helpline 1967.
